purpose: Establish the executable lifecycle vocabulary and guard matrix before cross-module transition work.
success_outcome: A deterministic backend projection and guard helper proves the complete FT-008 state machine without adding a second source of truth.
anti_goals: Do not implement provider webhooks, online payment creation, Admin UI, email delivery, or inventory mutation.
Do not create a custom lifecycle database or replace native Medusa statuses.

forbidden_scope: Admin UI or custom order API
reservation deletion, direct stock mutation, production data, secrets

success_checks: All six logical states and expired-to-canceled normalization are deterministic.
Allowed, forbidden, duplicate/no-op, and payment/order disagreement cases match the linked state and contract specs, including native Admin cancellation projection.

FT-007-origin order_canceled/refund notifications preserve checkout_state expired, timeout reason, and pending/complete cleanup state, including compatible existing expired records without the new origin marker.

Cancellation-origin payment_refunded keeps checkout_state canceled; partial refunds preserve the current logical state, and only persisted native refunds (or authoritative raw_refunded_amount) covering all persisted native captures (or raw_captured_amount) within native currency precision project refunded; no capture/refund status field is assumed.
Unknown event kinds and caller-supplied source, actor, status, payment, or target-metadata values are rejected before any lifecycle write.
No provider, Admin replacement, direct stock, or second order store is introduced.
evidence_required: Expired normalization and FT-007 expiry-origin/cleanup preservation assertions, including legacy compatibility.
Refund assertions cover cancellation origin, single/cumulative partials, final full refund, duplicate/out-of-order delivery, and no premature or canceled-to-refunded overwrite.
Unknown-event and caller-supplied source/actor/status/payment/metadata rejection output with no lifecycle mutation.

stop_conditions: Installed Medusa native status/payment/fulfillment fields cannot support a truthful projection.
The transition matrix conflicts with the linked FT-008 state spec or FT-007 expiry contract.
The pure model cannot distinguish FT-007 expiry-origin cancellation from operator cancellation without discarding cleanup state.
Authoritative native capture/refund totals or currency precision cannot support a deterministic cumulative full-refund predicate.
Verification cannot distinguish a no-op from a real duplicate side effect.
